closing.summary: Big strengths are fibre, easy comfort-food base with less baggage than junk food, and whole-food carb package, but the biggest weaknesses are low vitamin A, low iron, and low protein quality. It is good for practical meals, digestion, and energy and endurance sports because the food-type role makes it easy to build meals around, fibre supports digestion and steadier meals, and the carb section gives usable fuel.
